preconditions.description: The length of string t is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t consists only of characters '0' and '1'.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l1 <= n and 1 <= l2 <= n and 1 <= length <= n - max(l1, l2) + 1 for l1, l2, length in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, l1, l2 are between 1 and n inclusive, and length is between 1 and n - max(l1, l2) + 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(answer in ['YES', 'NO'] for answer in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer to a query is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
The number of answers is equal to the number of queries q.

postconditions.expression: all((t[l1-1:l1-1+length] == t[l2-1:l2-1+length]) or (t[l1-1:l1-1+length] == t[l2-1:l2-1+length][::-1].replace('0', '2').replace('1', '0').replace('2', '1')) for (l1, l2, length), answer in zip(queries, answers) if answer == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the substring t[l1 ... l1 + len - 1] is reachable from t[l2 ... l2 + len - 1] through the allowed operations.
